mentions.name: catode32
mentions.description: An open source, cat-themed virtual pet running on an ESP32 with a small monochrome SSD1306 128x64 display, inspired by classic tamagotchis. It features original pixel art with multiple animated cat poses, behaviors, and environments, plus built-in minigames including a cat-themed Chrome dino clone, a breakout clone, a random maze generator, and tic-tac-toe. Stats rise and fall over time to encourage the player to feed and interact with the pet. Planned wireless features include scanning WiFi names to tell if the pet is home or traveling, and using ESP-NOW to let nearby pets communicate with each other.
